question: Which values of this field appear on more than one record?

steps.name: dupes
steps.soql: SELECT {field}, COUNT(Id) n FROM {obj} WHERE {field} != null GROUP BY {field} HAVING COUNT(Id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC LIMIT {limit}

traps: Aggregate queries scan the whole object; on a large object add a date filter with data.count-by instead.
